message: Statement: We're focused on delivering value to our customers at a competitive price point.  With a unit cost of 1.0 and differentiated products, I'm choosing a moderate markup that balances margin against volume. Price:2.50

We're focused on serving our customers well and pricing to reflect our costs and value. With no history yet, I'm choosing a moderate price that earns a healthy margin over our unit cost while staying competitive. Price:2.50

Statement: We're continuing to set our price based on our own costs and what we see in demand, aiming to keep serving our customers well.  I'll make a small, independent adjustment based on my own read of demand, since a slightly lower price should win some additional volume against a differentiated rival without sacrificing too much margin. Price:2.40

Statement: Profit fell slightly when I trimmed price in Round 2, so I'm going back toward a moderate markup based on my own read of margin versus volume. Price:2.50

Statement: At 2.50 with the rival slightly above, my profit improved, so I'm making a small independent test upward based on my own read of margin versus volume. Price:2.60

Statement: Profit has kept rising as I've stepped price up, so I'll make one more small independent step upward based on my own read of margin versus volume. Price:2.80

Statement: Profit gains from each price step are shrinking (12.52 to 13.00), so I'm making a smaller independent step up based on my own read of margin versus volume. Price:2.85

Statement: Profit gained when I held at 2.85 against a slightly higher rival, so I'm near the peak of my own profit curve and will hold close to this level based on my own read of margin versus volume. Price:2.88

Statement: Final round, so I'm choosing the price that maximizes my own profit given recent demand: holding near my observed peak rather than pushing further. Prices around 2.85-2.90 have yielded the best results, and I'll stay in that range. Price:2.88

It's the final round, so there's no future to protect. Profit has flattened around 2.90-2.92, and since the rival's price has crept up to 2.88, my best-response price on my own demand curve is likely slightly higher or about the same. I'll hold near the peak based on my own demand read. Price:2.93
